extraction_design.inputs: /mnt/s/locomotion_data/gt21_author_mirror_2024/<ID>/<ID>.zip (AB23: AB23_attempt2/AB23.zip; the first AB23 download is .rejected and unused) with its acquisition manifest, result and the bound expected 2024 listing.

extraction_design.checks_before_any_write: zip sha256 and size equal the acquisition; every member name, size and CRC32 in the zip directory equal the manifest; every size equals the bound listing; no unsafe name, symlink, encryption or duplicate; disk free >= member bytes + 5 GiB.
extraction_design.checks_while_writing: 1 MiB streaming, exclusive create, fsync, recomputed size, CRC32 and sha256 equal the directory and the manifest.
extraction_design.deviation_from_acceptance: The acceptance line says the 2024 listing is re-read before each extraction. That is a network read of the live folder. The zips are already on disk and were verified by sha256 after the acquisition job re-listed the folder before and after download, so the runner re-hashes the zip instead and binds the listing. If José wants a fresh live re-listing of AB28 it is a separate network step.
extraction_design.ab17_2021_vs_2024: Already measured by GT21-S02 from central directories (converted_datasets/reconversion_v2/gt21_s02_author_mirror_20261031/AB17_v1_vs_2024_crc.json): 1464 identical, 136 only in 2024 (133 ik_offset + 3 static), 2 ramp id files differ in size. No separate comparison job is planned; the report should bind that file.

inventory_design: One stat-only job over the 16 local and 6 extracted participants; writes recording_ledger.jsonl (3,147 rows: subject, source, session, mode, recording, size of each of the 12 channel files) and inventory_summary.json with the per-mode count checks. This ledger is the index the merged plate/force plus model-fit pass can read once per recording. It does not open any MAT file.

native_extension.status: AB06 pilot run (r5 completed, clean); changes after the re-review need a short re-review; the other 21 not run
native_extension.exactly_what_it_will_run: One MATLAB R2023b start per participant, via PowerShell Start-Process (hidden, stdout and stderr to a log on S:): C:\Program Files\MATLAB\R2023b\bin\matlab.exe -batch "addpath('<repo script dir>'); gt21_rb01_label_export('<source root>','<new output folder>','AB##','<run nonce>')" -singleCompThread. The script reads SubjectInfo.mat and <source>/<ID>/<session>/<mode>/conditions/*.mat only, and writes labels_<ID>.jsonl (one line per recording: Label run windows with Header start/end, rampIncline, stairHeight, Speed range, column names) and subject_info_<ID>.json (all columns, VariableUnits, Weight literal to 17 digits) into the new folder, exclusively. It converts, filters and infers nothing. 22 starts, AB06 first (includes stair_1_l_01_02), local participants read from the repo source folder, the six from the extracted root.
native_extension.limits_enforced: timeout <= 1800 s; poll 15 s; Windows working set of the process tree <= 2048 MiB (polled); Windows free >= 2816 MiB at start and >= 2048 MiB while running; Linux available >= 3584 / 2048 MiB; output volume >= 5 GiB; envelope sha, bindings, no Linux or Windows worker (any running MATLAB refuses), one launch per ancestor via the existing ledger. No existing limit is changed.
native_extension.stop_and_cleanup: Only the recorded Windows PID tree, only after its creation time and the run nonce in its command line still match; taskkill /T, 30 s grace, then /F /T; afterwards the tree must be proven gone and the Windows census must show no new worker. Never stops by image name.
known_gaps_for_reviewer: Working-set cap is polled every 15 s, not enforced.
Whether bin\matlab.exe stays alive as parent for -batch is unverified (B2 covers both); the supervised AB06 pilot settles it.
After-run Windows census flags any new matlab* helper process; the pilot lists them before any exemption.
Earlier receipts record the pre-B1 launcher hash 8df6f115...; the launcher changed after those jobs only by the is_launcher_cli line.
native_extension.next_for_review: Independent reviewer checks the module and script against this list, runs tests, and records pass or changes. Only then the AB06 pilot (preflight dry run first), then the other 21 one at a time.

review_fixes.B2: When the recorded root PID has no row, find_matlab_by_nonce looks for matlab* processes whose command line carries the run nonce (3 tries, 2 s apart), adopts the earliest root, records from/to PID and creation time in receipt field adoptions, and keeps watching and stopping the adopted identity. A start_matlab exception triggers the same search; none found = launcher_error. Root gone with no orphan and outputs missing = failed_outputs_missing (never completed). Fake-host tests for each.
